name: Another Zen Card
description: A solid, glass-free theme: fixed palettes instead of the workspace gradient, the page and toolbar as one outlined card, and the accent kept for a few small touches.

card-tint.uc.js.name: Card helpers
card-tint.uc.js.description: Colors the toolbar from the top of the page, shows only the domain in the centered address bar, cross-fades the Library, moves the window buttons into the sidebar, opens extension popups from the Extensions button, themes the settings dialogs, keeps Customize Toolbar in the current layout, and leaves the address bar unfocused at startup.

author: TaouMou
